decisions.subject: Heavyweight book
decisions.lean: A confirmed-defensive rotation that presses the firm's highest-signal ideas while holding ~30% cash as a deliberate hedge, not a shrug. The tape is a Goldilocks quad with expanding liquidity BUT a validated risk_off radar (bubble/blow-off unwind 60/100, bubble_leadership 96%, leaders distributing) — and Flagship just confirmed the migration by dumping SMH/XLK/MTUM/ANET into financials + defensives. I concentrate into the five names that actually carry positive confluence and, where possible, size_authority UP: JNJ (22%, research 84, +0.33, UP) as the low-beta anchor; CFG (15%) as the single best-confluence expression (+0.43) of the freshly-thrusting financials cluster; CHRW (12%, +0.33, UP) for confirmed logistics leadership; AME (11%) for trend-confirmed quality industrial; ACIW (10%) for uncorrelated payments-software growth. One name per cluster (CFG over XLF/USB; CHRW over EXPD; JNJ over XLV/CI). I dropped CI/SWK (out of universe) and refused to press APH despite a 74 research score because Flagship's own cycle lens vetoed it today (cycle_blocked) — I don't fight the firm's veto. The 30% cash is the froth hedge: if the blow-off unwind triggers, it's my dry powder and downside buffer.

It is a rate-sensitive insurer inside the HK-Financials RS-leadership group (~92.9th percentile), geared to the building (if not-yet-transmitted) PBoC easing impulse, with defensive dividend support and zero exposure to the US-tech/USD channel driving tonight's risk-off. It is on the desk HK buy board tonight (BOTTOMING, constructive). On a night when Hang Seng is the most resilient major (-0.51%) and HK financials lead, this is the cleanest decoupled HK-China beta to hold; I keep it at ~14%.

positions.name: Tencent
positions.rationale: Tencent (0700.HK) remains my quality-tech offense anchor and the top FXI constituent, so I hold it for tracking-error control — but it carries the most beta in the book, and with VIX +4.96%, a global risk-off in force and the 10Y backing up, I trim it from ~9.5% to 8% to shave beta into a red open. Nasdaq futures are actually flat (+0.04%), so tech is not the epicenter and I do not want to abandon the FXI anchor; this is a measured shave, not a de-risk to zero.

positions.name: Power Assets
positions.rationale: Power Assets (0006.HK) is a low-beta, high-dividend HK utility — precisely the ballast to hold with global vol rising (VIX +4.96%) and Europe/Japan/Korea tape deeply red. It is insulated from the global tech/cyclical selloff and from HKD-peg pressure (the USD is soft tonight in any case). A rising 10Y is a mild valuation headwind, but its domestic, defensive cashflow profile keeps it as the anchor of the book's defensive base. Held at ~3%.

decisions.subject: China book
decisions.lean: OVERNIGHT REVIEW hold-with-minor-de-risk. The live tape is a broad global risk-off led by Korea (KOSPI -4.91%), Europe (DAX -2.23%, Euro Stoxx -1.82%, FTSE -1.66%) and Japan (Nikkei -2.12%), with VIX +4.96% and the US 10Y +0.88% — but the epicenter is NOT China: Hang Seng is the most resilient major at -0.51%, Shanghai -1.26%, and the US Dollar is soft (-0.13%), removing the USD-squeeze that would normally hurt HK. My book already sits ~61% cash with a defensive spine (insurer + SOE-bank dividend carry + utility + decorrelated pharma) and one HK-listed tech anchor, so it is structurally built for this tape. Rather than lurch to an even more extreme underweight vs FXI on a night when China is the relative haven, I honor the ROTATE_DEFENSIVE posture by shaving my highest-beta name (Tencent 0006—Tencent 0700.HK) into the open and holding the defensive ballast unchanged. Net invested drops ~39%→~37%; the large cash buffer remains the primary shock absorber.
decisions.thesis: No outright exits. Only trimmed Tencent (0700.HK) from ~9.5% to 8% to shave the book's highest-beta exposure into a risk-off open; the ~1.5pt released goes to cash. All defensive holdings held at prior sizes.
